FACT_ID: sec06-F01 | anchor: A01
Greater crash speed increases the potential for severe injury. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F02 | anchor: A01
An unrestrained occupant can keep moving forward after the vehicle stops in a crash. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F03 | anchor: A01
Internal organs can continue moving after the body strikes the vehicle interior, causing internal injury. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F04 | anchor: A01
Proper restraints help control the crash forces imposed on occupants. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F05 | anchor: A01
The guide recommends buckling up on every trip and observing speed limits. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec06-F06 | anchor: A02
Louisiana’s belt requirement in the guide covers front-seat and rear-seat occupants of cars, vans and pickup trucks. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F07 | anchor: A02
A lap belt should fit closely across the hips rather than rest over the abdomen. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F08 | anchor: A02
The shoulder portion of the belt belongs over the shoulder and across the chest. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F09 | anchor: A02
A belt helps keep an occupant inside the vehicle during a collision. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F10 | anchor: A02
An unbelted rear passenger can strike other occupants during a crash. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F11 | anchor: A02
A properly worn belt helps keep the driver at the controls after an impact. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec06-F12 | anchor: A03
Children need a restraint suited to their age or size that meets applicable federal safety standards. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec06-F13 | anchor: A04
When a child meets several restraint categories, the guide directs choosing the more protective category. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F14 | anchor: A04
Never carry a child on a lap while traveling or place an adult and child inside one belt. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F15 | anchor: A04
A child must not ride standing on the vehicle seat. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F16 | anchor: A04
Airbags supplement belts rather than replace the need to buckle up. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F17 | anchor: A04
The guide recommends steering-wheel hand positions of nine and three or eight and four in vehicles with airbags. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F18 | anchor: A04
The guide directs the driver to remain at least ten inches from an airbag-equipped steering wheel. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F19 | anchor: A04
If the steering wheel tilts, aim it toward the chest and away from the head. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec06-F20 | anchor: A05
Adjust the head restraint before driving to help protect against whiplash. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F21 | anchor: A05
Active safety technology assists in preventing a collision; passive protection helps occupants during one. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F22 | anchor: A05
Reverse sensors and backup cameras assist in detecting obstacles behind the vehicle. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F23 | anchor: A05
Blind-spot warning equipment assists with hazards that may be difficult to see. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F24 | anchor: A05
Lane-departure warning alerts a driver to an unintended movement out of the travel lane. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F25 | anchor: A05
Adaptive cruise control adjusts following distance behind a vehicle ahead. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F26 | anchor: A05
Automatic braking can help prevent a crash or reduce its severity. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec06-F27 | anchor: A06
Traction-control equipment responds when driven wheels begin spinning. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F28 | anchor: A06
Electronic stability control intervenes when loss of vehicle control is approaching. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F29 | anchor: A06
Crashworthiness describes how well a vehicle structure protects occupants during impact. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F30 | anchor: A06
Crumple zones absorb and redirect collision forces away from the passenger area. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F31 | anchor: A06
Interior padding reduces contact with hard vehicle surfaces during a crash. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F32 | anchor: A06
A cargo barrier can help separate unsecured cargo from the passenger space. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F33 | anchor: A06
Vehicle lights and reflectors communicate location, dimensions, travel direction and driver actions to other road users. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec06-F34 | anchor: A07
Correct a vehicle defect that could impair safe operation as soon as possible. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F35 | anchor: A07
Inspect the vehicle before a trip to identify conditions affecting safe travel. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F36 | anchor: A07
The guide’s weekly checklist calls for at least one-sixteenth inch of tire tread depth. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F37 | anchor: A07
Inspect tires for uneven wear, cracking, bulges or separation of the tread. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F38 | anchor: A07
Check oil against the dipstick’s specified operating range. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F39 | anchor: A07
Look for battery leakage or terminal corrosion and for fluid leaks in the engine area. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F40 | anchor: A07
Check that headlamps, rear lamps and turn signals work and have intact lenses. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F41 | anchor: A07
Include the horn, fuel-cap fit and worn or malfunctioning belts in vehicle checks. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F42 | anchor: A07
Check mirrors, windows and the wiper-swept part of the windshield for cracks. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F43 | anchor: A07
A license plate should remain readable and retain its reflective condition. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F44 | anchor: A07
Dispose of used oil and batteries according to local requirements instead of discarding them carelessly. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec06-F45 | anchor: A08
Check brake lights, hazard flashers and the condition of windshield-wiper blades. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F46 | anchor: A08
Inspect the spare tire, jack and emergency equipment for usable condition. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F47 | anchor: A08
Use the vehicle manual to locate fluid reservoirs and determine their proper levels. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F48 | anchor: A08
Let the engine cool before under-hood checks and apply the parking brake during the inspection. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F49 | anchor: A08
Before getting in, walk around the vehicle and look ahead, behind and underneath for obstacles or nearby children. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F50 | anchor: A08
Before starting, clear the windows, adjust the seat and mirrors, close and lock doors and buckle occupants. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F51 | anchor: A08
Adjust the seat so the pedals and other controls can be reached safely. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F52 | anchor: A08
Check the gauges, wipers and washer-fluid supply before departure. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec06-F53 | anchor: A08
Be physically and mentally prepared to drive, and never drive while impaired. [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0050]
